T: We are Venom. We are hungry.
D: A disgraced reporter bonds with an alien symbiote that has a big appetite.
P: Serve the mains when Eddie climbs into the lobster tank at the restaurant.
S: Crispy potato gems with sriracha mayo
Oven baked potato gems with a garlic and sriracha mayo
Frozen potato gems baked at 220C for 20 minutes until crunchy, with a chilli and garlic mayo.
Crispy chicken in a soy and honey glaze, rolled in black sesame
Chicken pieces fried crisp, tossed in a sticky soy and honey glaze, coated in black sesame seeds.
M: Lobster tank garlic butter lobster tails
Grilled lobster tails with garlic parsley butter, double fried fries

Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic and herb butter, grilled 6 minutes, with fries and lemon. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and fry twice until crisp. Split 4 lobster tails, brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic and parsley, and grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Serve with the fries and lemon wedges. Tater tots optional.
Eddie and Venom starving at all hours

Double beef patties with melted cheddar, crisp bacon and pickles in toasted buns, with a pile of crunchy double-cooked fries. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and cook at 140C for 6 minutes, then drain. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Shape 800g beef mince into 8 thin patties, season and grill 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar slices for the last minute. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes and salt. Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties each with bacon, pickles, onion, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: Chilled mango pudding set with gelatine, fresh mango cubes on top

Silky Hong Kong mango pudding set in glasses, with a pour of evaporated milk over the top and fresh mango cubes. Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with 80g caster sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside. Stir in the gelatine, then 200ml evaporated milk and 100ml cream. Pour into 4 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Just before serving, pour a little evaporated milk over each and top with mango cubes.
K: Strong black tea with condensed milk, poured over ice
Strong black tea sweetened with condensed milk, chilled and poured over ice with a splash of milk.

s.note: Crispy chicken in a soy and honey glaze, rolled in black sesame
s.how: Toss 600g chicken thigh pieces in cornflour and fry until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp soy sauce with 3 tbsp honey until bubbling and toss the chicken through. Roll in black sesame seeds until coated and dark. Serve on toothpicks.

s.n: Crispy potato gems with sriracha mayo
s.note: Oven baked potato gems with a garlic and sriracha mayo
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen potato gems at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crunchy. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp sriracha and 1 crushed garlic clove. Serve the gems in a big bowl with the mayo for dunking.

m.n: Lobster tank garlic butter lobster tails
m.note: Grilled lobster tails with garlic parsley butter, double fried fries
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and fry twice until crisp. Split 4 lobster tails, brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic and parsley, and grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Serve with the fries and lemon wedges. Tater tots optional.

w.note: Chilled mango pudding set with gelatine, fresh mango cubes on top
w.how: Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with 80g caster sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside. Stir in the gelatine, then 200ml evaporated milk and 100ml cream. Pour into 4 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Just before serving, pour a little evaporated milk over each and top with mango cubes.

d.note: Strong black tea with condensed milk, poured over ice
d.how: Steep 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes, remove, stir in 4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk and chill. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and top each with a splash of cold milk.
